SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN CATEGORY_CD = '01ISSUECATE' AND STATUS_CD != '04ISSUESTAT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bGoCount,
SUM(CASE WHEN CATEGORY_CD = '01ISSUECATE' AND STATUS_CD = '04ISSUESTAT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bEndCount,
SUM(CASE WHEN CATEGORY_CD = '02ISSUECATE' AND STATUS_CD != '04ISSUESTAT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fGoCount,
SUM(CASE WHEN CATEGORY_CD = '02ISSUECATE' AND STATUS_CD = '04ISSUESTAT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fEndCount,
SUM(CASE WHEN CATEGORY_CD = '03ISSUECATE' AND STATUS_CD != '04ISSUESTAT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wGoCount,
SUM(CASE WHEN CATEGORY_CD = '03ISSUECATE' AND STATUS_CD = '04ISSUESTAT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wEndCount,
SUM(CASE WHEN CATEGORY_CD = '04ISSUECATE' AND STATUS_CD != '04ISSUESTAT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS iGoCount,
SUM(CASE WHEN CATEGORY_CD = '04ISSUECATE' AND STATUS_CD = '04ISSUESTAT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS iEndCount
FROM issue WHERE prj_id = #{prjId}
select prj_id,title,created_on from notice where prj_id = #{prjId} order by created_on desc
SELECT g.id as grpId, g.name as grpName, COUNT(m.user_id) as count FROM grp g INNER JOIN member m ON g.id = m.grp_id WHERE g.prj_id = #{prjId} GROUP BY g.id, g.name ORDER BY g.id ASC
